mechanism: Both turmeric (curcumin) and piroxicam inhibit platelet aggregation and have anticoagulant/antiplatelet effects, increasing bleeding risk; additionally, both may inhibit CYP3A4 and compete for protein binding.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider alternative NSAIDs with lower bleeding risk or separate dosing intervals; counsel patient to report unusual bruising, bleeding, or blood in stool/urine.
